posts.text:
This is another awful reminder of the risks that our police officers face every day. I spoke to an officer from the area this afternoon to let him know we’re ready to help in any way to maximally protect our men & women in blue. They’re dealing with a lot in Wayne County right now, and our hearts go out to them. In the meantime, let’s pray for the family of Sgt. Scott Ries and for the recovery of the injured officers.


Senator Rob McColley (@Rob_McColley)

What a tragedy and a sobering reminder
